response.sql: WITH dept AS (SELECT m.department AS department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member me JOIN major m ON me.link_to_major = m.major_id GROUP BY m.department), shares AS (SELECT department, member_count, member_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(member_count) FROM dept) AS share FROM dept), avg_s AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.department, s.member_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_average FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_s a WHERE s.share >= a.avg_share ORDER BY s.share DESC

assumptions.assumption: Members are counted by inner-joining member to major, so members with no matching major are excluded. Departments are grouped by the major.department value, and the average share is taken across the departments that have at least one member.
